svg.title: US and Hong Kong books, measured apart
svg.desc: Us Book +75.07%, +US$1,870 on US$2,491 (true_principal). Hk Book −45.82%, −HK$48,310 on HK$105,427 (net_principal). Combined −26.91% in USD (mixed). Each return is total P&L (realized + unrealized) divided by the basis named under it; the bases differ and the currencies are not added. Daily total P&L per book from 2026-06-09 to 2026-10-12. Source: dashboard.json on the data plane.
